title: Adversarial Training for Process Reward Models
authors_zh: Gurusha Juneja、Deepak Nathani、William Yang Wang（加州大学圣塔芭芭拉分校）
paper_type_zh: 对抗式过程监督构造与过程奖励模型训练研究
best_for_zh: 适合设计步骤级奖励模型自适应负样本课程的读者。
one_line: APRM trains a generator to create PRM-deceiving wrong steps and continuously feeds those hard negatives back into process reward modeling.
APRM 训练生成器制造能欺骗过程奖励模型的错误步骤，并持续把这些难负样本反馈给过程奖励模型训练。
why: It changes the source and hardness distribution of negative process labels as the reward model improves.
inclusion_reason: It adaptively generates and mixes hard negative reasoning steps into PRM training instead of holding the error distribution fixed.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Static process-label datasets expose a reward model to a fixed set of errors. As a solver and its reward model become stronger, the remaining failures can be subtler than the original negatives, so a PRM trained on old corruptions may miss the errors that matter most during later search and selection.

APRM asks how a process reward model can receive progressively harder negative steps without paying for manual labels. It frames data construction as an adversarial interaction: a generator tries to corrupt a correct step in a way that deceives the current PRM, while the PRM learns from those newly targeted failures.

静态过程标签数据集只让奖励模型接触固定的一组错误。随着求解器和奖励模型变强，剩余失败可能比原有负样本更微妙，因此在旧错误上训练的过程奖励模型可能会漏掉之后搜索和选择中最重要的错误。

APRM 询问，过程奖励模型如何在不支付人工标注成本的情况下接收逐渐变难的负向步骤。它将数据构造表述为对抗互动：生成器试图以能欺骗当前过程奖励模型的方式破坏正确步骤，而过程奖励模型则从这些新近针对性的失败中学习。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The core idea is an adaptive negative-data curriculum. A generator is rewarded only when it creates an invalid step that the PRM calls correct; the PRM is rewarded for correct classification. Their competition changes the negative distribution as the PRM's current weaknesses change.

The resulting dataset is not merely synthetic text. Each record contains a reference-derived valid step, a perturbation, an oracle validity decision, and the versioned adversarial source that produced it. The PRM trains on an even mixture of gold steps and current or historical hard negatives so that it learns new mistakes without forgetting earlier ones.

核心思想是一种自适应负数据课程。只有当生成器创造无效步骤且过程奖励模型将其判为正确时，生成器才获得奖励；过程奖励模型则因正确分类获得奖励。二者的竞争会随着过程奖励模型当前弱点的变化而改变负样本分布。

得到的数据集不只是合成文本。每条记录包含从参考答案得来的有效步骤、一个扰动、一个预言机有效性判断，以及产生它的带版本对抗来源。过程奖励模型在金标准步骤与当前或历史难负样本的均匀混合上训练，从而既学习新错误又不遗忘旧错误。

title: Method
方法
html:
Both players use Llama-3.1-8B and train on MATH gold solution steps. The generator proposes a perturbed step; an algorithmic oracle compares it with the reference through cosine similarity, noun and number entities, and logical-operation order. The PRM labels the step correct or incorrect, while the generator and PRM receive asymmetric rewards based on whether an invalid perturbation fooled the PRM.

Training alternates five PPO updates of one player while the other is frozen. The paper adds KL penalties and entropy bonuses to both policies and uses optimistic gradient descent-ascent for the general-sum game. The PRM's training mixture is half gold steps and half negatives from the current or earlier generators, then its scores guide matched-budget solver selection.

两个参与者都使用 Llama-3.1-8B，并在 MATH 金标准解答步骤上训练。生成器提出一个扰动步骤；算法预言机通过余弦相似度、名词和数字实体以及逻辑操作顺序与参考答案比较。过程奖励模型将该步骤标为正确或错误，而生成器和过程奖励模型根据无效扰动是否欺骗了过程奖励模型获得不对称奖励。

训练时，一方进行五次 PPO 更新，另一方冻结。论文为两个策略加入 KL 惩罚和熵奖励，并为这个一般和博弈使用乐观梯度下降上升。过程奖励模型的训练混合一半是金标准步骤，一半是当前或早期生成器的负样本，之后其分数在匹配预算下引导求解器选择。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Across five mathematics benchmarks and matched test-time budgets, APRM reports an average 3.4-point improvement over the strongest PRM baseline. With GPT-OSS-120B, its average is 83.0 versus 81.7 for ReST-MCTS; with GPT-OSS-20B, it is 85.0 versus 82.3. The reported largest out-of-distribution gain is 5.3 points.

The paper also compares prompting, static hard negatives, and MCTS-derived PRM data. These results support the narrower empirical claim that the adaptive generator produces more useful negatives than a fixed collection in the evaluated mathematical settings, although the work remains under review and needs independent replication.

在五个数学基准和匹配的测试时预算下，APRM 报告相对最强过程奖励模型基线平均提高 3.4 个点。使用 GPT-OSS-120B 时，其平均分为 83.0，而 ReST-MCTS 为 81.7；使用 GPT-OSS-20B 时，其平均分为 85.0，而 ReST-MCTS 为 82.3。报告的最大分布外提升为 5.3 个点。

论文还比较了提示法、静态难负样本和由 MCTS 得到的过程奖励模型数据。这些结果支持一个更窄的经验主张：在评估的数学设置中，自适应生成器产生的负样本比固定集合更有用，不过该工作仍在审稿中，需要独立复现。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Most automatic PRM pipelines collect errors once, through rollouts, search, or fixed perturbation rules. APRM makes the negative generator a training participant whose objective is explicitly tied to current PRM failures, converting the reward model's error boundary into a moving data-collection target.

Its other distinctive choice is preserving historical negatives alongside current ones. That turns the data mixture into a curriculum with memory: new examples target present blind spots, while past examples protect against forgetting. The card is included for this changing training-record policy, not for the game-theoretic optimizer alone.

多数自动过程奖励模型流程通过轨迹展开、搜索或固定扰动规则一次性收集错误。APRM 将负样本生成器变成训练参与者，其目标明确绑定到当前过程奖励模型的失败，从而把奖励模型的错误边界转化为不断移动的数据收集目标。

另一个独特选择是将历史负样本与当前负样本一起保留。这使数据混合成为带记忆的课程：新样例针对当前盲点，过去样例防止遗忘。本卡纳入的原因是这种不断变化的训练记录策略，而不是仅仅因为它使用了博弈论优化器。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The validity oracle is heuristic, so it can mistake a subtle but valid reformulation for an error or miss an invalid derivation. Adversarial PPO also costs more than static-data training, and the theoretical policy-space guarantees do not ensure stable large neural-model training. The evaluation is centered on mathematical reasoning and the paper is still under review.
有效性预言机是启发式的，因此可能把微妙但有效的改写误认为错误，或漏掉无效推导。对抗式 PPO 的成本也高于静态数据训练，而且策略空间中的理论保证并不确保大型神经模型训练稳定。评测以数学推理为中心，论文仍在审稿中。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work when static process negatives no longer exercise a reward model. Its reusable unit is the versioned hard-negative record, not simply the final PRM: store the original step, perturbation, oracle outcome, PRM error, and generator version so that error hardness and failures can be audited. It is especially relevant where human step labels are scarce but reference solutions make constrained corruption feasible.
当静态过程负样本不再能检验奖励模型时，可使用这项工作。它可复用的单位是带版本的难负样本记录，而不只是最终过程奖励模型：应保存原始步骤、扰动、预言机结果、过程奖励模型错误和生成器版本，使错误难度和失败能够被审计。它尤其适合人工步骤标签稀缺、但参考解答使受约束扰动可行的场景。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the paper as adaptive negative-data generation. Inspect the oracle before accepting the adversarial labels, verify whether historical negatives are retained, and compare improvements at equal candidate budgets. Before applying it outside math, replace the oracle with a domain-appropriate validity contract and separately measure whether generated negatives are valid errors rather than merely unusual wording.
应把论文作为自适应负数据生成来阅读。接受对抗标签前先检查预言机，核实是否保留历史负样本，并在相同候选预算下比较提升。应用到数学以外前，应将预言机替换为领域合适的有效性契约，并单独测量生成的负样本是否真是有效错误，而不只是罕见表述。
